title: SoulCalibur (USA)

codes.desc: Unlock every fighter (flag table index 1-20: Hwang, Yoshimitsu, Rock, Siegfried, Lizardman, Seung Mina, Cervantes, Edge Master and the rest)
Inferno and the extras bitfield (bits 0-15 of 0x8C336E54; the game sets bit 15 for Inferno)

scope: the extras bits that share Inferno's halfword

evidence.source: libretro-database Soul Calibur.cht gives five flags (Hwang 0x336DFE, Yoshimitsu 0x336E0A, Rock 0x336E16, Siegfried 0x336E1E, Lizardman 0x336E2A). The game's own code (RAM dump of 1ST_READ, SH-4) shows they are entries of one table: 0x8C0E1A5C clears and 0x8C0E1A78 increments the u16 at 0x8C336DFA + 4*i for 1 <= i < 21 (literal at 0x8C0E1AA8), and 0x8C0E1ACE sets bit 0x8000 of the u32 at 0x8C336820 + 0x634 for i == 21 (Inferno). The five database flags are indices 1, 4, 7, 9 and 12.
evidence.read_back: 2026-10-19 ~21:00 CST, i9-NUC, RetroArch Flycast agent session: the codes were held with cheats op=add and read_memory read every written value back after 1-8 s (writes go through RetroArch's RAM view, core_ram, read-back confirmed). Character-select frames are pending: the NUC's frame capture returned one black frame until gBox is relaunched there (PR #662 adds RetroArch's own screenshot). Read back: flags 1..20 all 1, 0x8C336E54 = ffff0000.
